full_text_en:
He Peiping v. Wuxian Economic and Technological Development Research Institute — dispute over infringement of utility model patent

Plaintiff: He Peiping, male, 32 years old, a teacher at the Management Station of Lianshui County Radio and Television University, Jiangsu Province.

Agent ad litem: Liu Pilie and Shen Bilian, lawyers of Nanjing Maritime Law Firm, Jiangsu Province.

Defendant: Jiangsu Province Wuxian Economic and Technological Development Research Institute.

Legal representative: Chen Binggeng, director.

Agent ad litem: Shi Shiying, head of the Building Materials Research Office, Wuxian Economic and Technological Development Research Institute.

Agent ad litem: Tan Zhen, lawyer of Nanjing First Law Firm, Jiangsu Province.

Plaintiff He Peiping filed a lawsuit with the Nanjing Intermediate People's Court of Jiangsu Province against the defendant Jiangsu Province Wuxian Economic and Technological Development Research Institute for infringement of utility model patent.

Plaintiff's Allegations: The "integral small green tile" is the plaintiff's patent. The "new multi-section tile" developed by the defendant has its main shape features within the scope of the plaintiff's patent protection, infringing the plaintiff's patent rights. The plaintiff requests the defendant to cease the infringement and compensate for economic losses.

Defendant's Defense: The "new multi-section tile" developed by the defendant differs from the plaintiff's "integral small green tile" in shape, process, material, etc. This was independently conceived and developed by the defendant, and a patent application was filed before the plaintiff's patent was published, so there is no fact of infringement.

The Nanjing Intermediate People's Court lawfully formed a collegial panel and, after a public hearing, found the following facts:

The plaintiff He Peiping's "integral small green tile" is a new type of roof covering tile, developed in June 1986. On July 17 of the same year, the plaintiff filed a utility model patent application with the Patent Office of the PRC (patent application No. CN86203975), claiming the scope of protection as: (1) being in the shape of an arc cylinder; (2) having a step at a certain distance on both the inner and outer surfaces of the tile; (3) having a width equal to that of small green tiles, with a length of 4-7 stages, and a stage spacing of approximately 30-50 cm. The Patent Office published the application on November 7, 1987, and granted He Peiping the utility model patent for "integral small green tile" on February 28, 1988.

The defendant Wuxian Economic and Technological Development Research Institute's "new multi-section tile" was filed as a utility model patent application with the Patent Office on October 4, 1987 (patent application No. CN87212348). The claimed scope of protection is: (1) being in the shape of an arc; (2) the front of the cover tile and bottom tile being multi-section; (3) the length of each section of the cover tile being equal to its width, generally 4-7 sections, each section approximately 30-60 cm; (4) the front edge of the cover tile having a groove on the reverse side with a width of 0.5-1 cm and a depth of 0.3-0.8 cm, the rear edge of the bottom tile having a protrusion on the front side, the cover and bottom tiles being connected and fitted by concave-convex engagement; (5) the bottom tile having a flat surface for stability. The Patent Office published the application on August 4, 1988. Thereafter, the defendant transferred the "new multi-section tile" technology to 18 units for use, obtaining transfer fees of 262,000 yuan, and after deducting mold costs, training fees, taxes, etc., obtained net profit of 55,000 yuan.

In July 1988, the plaintiff He Peiping learned from television and newspaper advertisements that the main shape features of the "new multi-section tile" technology being transferred by the defendant fell within the protection scope of the "integral small green tile" patent, and filed a lawsuit with the court on the grounds that the defendant had infringed his patent.

The Nanjing Intermediate People's Court held: Article 59 of the Patent Law of the PRC provides that whether another person has infringed the patent right of the patentee shall be determined based on the scope of protection claimed by the patentee. The plaintiff's "integral small green tile" claims a protection scope of "arc cylindrical shape with steps"; the defendant's "new multi-section tile" has main shape features of "arc shape with multiple sections". Although the wording is different, the substance is the same. Therefore, the main shape features of the defendant's "new multi-section tile" infringe the claims protected by the plaintiff's patent right. Although the "new multi-section tile" differs from the "integral small green tile" in dimensions, material, color, etc., these are not part of the overall inventive concept and do not constitute substantive technical breakthroughs, and do not affect the finding of infringement.

The defendant's "new multi-section tile" has new technical features such as "concave-convex connection and fitting" and "flat surface for stability", which are not included in the protection scope of the plaintiff's "integral small green tile" patent and constitute new inventions. Therefore, these two new technologies do not constitute infringement. However, the implementation of these two new technologies by the defendant depends on the implementation of the plaintiff's "integral small green tile" utility model. Therefore, the fact that the main shape features of the defendant's "new multi-section tile" infringe cannot be denied.

According to the "first-to-file" principle stipulated in Article 9 of the Patent Law, the defendant's argument that it had applied for a patent earlier than the publication of the plaintiff's patent, thereby claiming no infringement, cannot be sustained.

Based on the above facts and reasons, in accordance with Article 95 of the General Principles of the Civil Law of the PRC, the patent right obtained by the plaintiff He Peiping is protected by law. In accordance with Article 118 of the General Principles of the Civil Law, the plaintiff He Peiping's request for the defendant to cease the infringement and compensate for losses is justified and shall be supported. Given that the profits obtained by the defendant from transferring the patented technology are related to its two new technologies, appropriate compensation may be considered.

Accordingly, the Nanjing Intermediate People's Court rendered its judgment on April 22, 1989:

1. The defendant shall immediately cease transferring the infringing part of the "new multi-section tile" technology, i.e., the arc-shaped and multi-section portions.

2. The defendant shall compensate the plaintiff for losses in the amount of 25,000 yuan, to be paid in a lump sum within 10 days after the judgment takes effect.

After the first-instance judgment was pronounced, both parties indicated acceptance.

After the judgment was served, the plaintiff and the defendant requested the court to mediate the transfer of the patent right for the "integral small green tile". Considering that the defendant's "new multi-section tile" technology was indeed more refined and practical than the plaintiff's "integral small green tile", but that the defendant's implementation of this technology required the plaintiff's permission by law, and in order to promote the development of science and technology, to facilitate the rapid transformation of patented technology into productive forces, and to better serve socialist construction, the Nanjing Intermediate People's Court mediated and the plaintiff and defendant reached the following agreement on April 24, 1989:

1. The plaintiff transfers to the defendant the patent rights for the utility model "integral small green tile" and "integral small green tile mold", with a transfer fee of 10,000 yuan, to be paid by the defendant in a lump sum to the plaintiff within one month after both parties complete the relevant formalities for patent transfer at the Patent Office;

2. The plaintiff withdraws the opposition filed with the Patent Office against the defendant's patent application;

3. The plaintiff provides guidance to the defendant regarding the implementation of the "integral small green tile" technology.
